title: Largest gaps between bulk eigenvalues of unitary-invariant random Hermitian matrices
summary: We study $n\times n$ random Hermitian matrix ensembles that are invariant under unitary conjugation. Let $I$ be a finite union of intervals lying in the bulk, and let $m_{k}^{(n)}$ be the $k$-th largest gap between consecutive eigenvalues lying in $I$.
